name: facebook_games_docs
summary: FacebookGamesAdapter — splices into doc_parser.ADAPTERS at import time and parses Facebook for Developers / Games doc pages into ParserCursor-shaped JSONL. Detects FB pages via og:site_name='Facebook for Developers' / title substrings / body markers; emits CursorNodes typed as section, sdk_method, code_sample, guide_link, doc. Falls back to doc_parser._generic_walk when the page doesn't match. Driver script fetches 8 canonical URLs over stdlib urllib with 2s polite cadence and a 60s wall budget; emits one summary InferenceLogger crystal per ingest run plus a per-page crystal anchor via doc_parser._log_anchor.
engine_pattern: import doc_parser_facebook_games (auto-registers) -> doc_parser.parse_url('facebook_games', URL) -> html.parser.HTMLParser via _StructuredHTMLCollector -> FacebookGamesAdapter.parse() yields CursorNode -> ParserWriter writes JSONL -> InferenceLogger.log() per page + one summary log per run

adapter.name: facebook_games
signature_signals: title contains 'Facebook for Developers' / 'Facebook Gaming' / 'Instant Games'
body markers 'developers.facebook.com/docs/games', 'instant games', 'graph api', 'facebook gaming services'
node_types_emitted: section (h1 / h2 / h3 with section_level attr; h1_context/h2_context for nesting)
definition (doc — <dd> bodies bound to last term)
code (code_sample — <pre><code>... with language hint detected from class attr or content sniff)
adapter.language_detection: FacebookGamesAdapter._detect_language sniffs class attrs (javascript/typescript/python/java/kotlin/swift/objectivec/csharp/cpp/ruby/php/go/rust/bash/shell/html/json/xml/yaml), then content head (JSON/HTML/JS/bash) — returns 'unknown' on miss

output_paths.node_shape: ParserCursor JSONL — {type, name, data, attributes, parent, depth}

graceful_failure_modes: 403 (Meta anti-scrape): per-URL entry tagged ok=false, ingest continues
429 (rate limited): per-URL entry tagged ok=false, ingest continues
timeout / URLError: per-URL entry tagged ok=false with error msg
parse exception: caught, error recorded, ingest continues
wall deadline exceeded: remaining URLs marked status=-1 'skipped'
ingest_protocol.exit_code: 0 if any URL succeeded, 2 if all failed (re-runnable)

dag_routing.consumer: core/lib/dag_loop.py::load_docs() walks studio/assets/_doc_corpus/facebook_games/*.jsonl and emits LoopNode(kind='doc', sub_dag='DOCS', source='doc_parser') for each one. INDEX.json is informational, not enumerated as a node (only *.jsonl is).
dag_routing.downstream_passes: studio/passes/registry.py — pass_06_doc_index (planned) discovers _doc_corpus/<adapter>/*.jsonl files for embedding into the inference loop

outbound_calls: inference_logger.InferenceLogger.log() (tier='documentation', model='doc_parser:facebook_games', scope='games_ingest_run' for the run-level crystal; tier='documentation', model='doc_parser' for per-page anchors)

guarantees: Stdlib only — no BeautifulSoup, no lxml, no pip installs
DOES NOT modify doc_parser.py — registers via runtime splice into ADAPTERS dict
Deterministic — same HTML bytes -> same CursorNode order -> same JSONL bytes -> same crystal hash
Idempotent — re-running overwrites existing per-page JSONL with identical bytes when content unchanged
Polite — 2s between requests, 12s per-request timeout, 60s total wall budget
Graceful — 403/429/timeout/parse-failure per URL never aborts the ingest run
Crystal-anchored — per-page anchor + one summary anchor every run join the master chain
constraints: Does NOT modify core/lib/doc_parser.py, core/cc, cc.sh, .env
ParserCursor JSONL shape is the only output format (interop with the existing cursor stack)
Meta may 403 our User-Agent — adapter + ingest framework still ship as deliverables even with zero successful fetches
smoke_test: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'core/lib'); from doc_parser_facebook_games import register; register(); import doc_parser; print('facebook_games' in doc_parser.ADAPTERS)"  # registry splice
bash core/scripts/facebook_games_ingest.sh  # full ingest; reports per-URL status + total cursor nodes + ingest crystal
usage_example:
# from a python repl / a pass:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'core/lib')
import doc_parser_facebook_games  # auto-registers
import doc_parser
out = doc_parser.parse_url('facebook_games', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/games/')
# out -> studio/assets/_doc_corpus/facebook_games/<crystal>.jsonl
from parser_cursor import ParserCursor, ERR_FILE_EOF
cur = ParserCursor()
cur.open(out)
while cur.read() != ERR_FILE_EOF:
    print(cur.get_node_name(), cur.get_node_data())
